title: Verse Read Request 1
description: The request of the reading check; the recording he made travels beside it as the grist's one attachment.

target_text.description: The text he was to read: the English of the verse, or its Greek words in order. The mill scores the recording against it.

lang.description: The language the mill scores in (the grind's scoring.langs): en for English, el for the Greek read in modern pronunciation.
